get.description:
Stream every bus event as SSE.

With an ``x-skene-directory`` header, only that workspace's events (plus
server-wide ones like heartbeats) are delivered; without it the stream
is unfiltered — unlike the REST routes, which fall back to the server
cwd, a global observer is the more useful default for an event tap.

post.description:
Start the canned journey analysis in a fresh session.

The run proceeds async: watch ``/event`` for progress; the result lands
as an ``artifact`` part (and as ``journey.yaml`` in the workspace).

get.description: Latest ``journey.yaml`` for the workspace, parsed to JSON.

Registered agents: primaries are promptable, subagents are reachable
only through a primary agent's ``task`` tool.
The server's resolved LLM configuration, secrets redacted.
Supported LLM providers; ``active`` marks the one the server runs with.

AgentInfo.title: AgentInfo
AgentInfo.description:
A registered agent as exposed by ``GET /agent``.

``primary`` agents are user-selectable; ``subagent`` agents are only
reachable through a primary agent's ``task`` tool.

path.title: Path
path.description: Required when source == 'code'. File path inside the repo.

table.title: Table
table.description: Required when source == 'db'. Table or collection name.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: A pointer back to the code path or DB table that justifies a feature.

Feature.title: Feature
Feature.description: A product feature emitted by a subagent — one feature-map entry.

FeaturePart.title: FeaturePart
FeaturePart.description:
A feature emitted by an analysis agent's ``emit_feature``.

Streams live from subagent runs — features carry no stage or
milestone assignment; milestone synthesis happens later in
``synthesize_journey`` and is only visible in the ``journey.yaml``
artifact, not retroactively on these parts.

JourneyAnalyseAccepted.title: JourneyAnalyseAccepted
JourneyAnalyseAccepted.description: Ack for ``POST /journey/analyse``: the run proceeds async in this session.

JourneyAnalyseRequest.title: JourneyAnalyseRequest
JourneyAnalyseRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /journey/analyse`` — the v1-compat canned analysis.

Mirrors the ``skene analyse-journey`` CLI flags. ``db_url`` is used for
live introspection only and is never persisted or echoed back — the
stored session records a redacted display form.

MessageWithParts.title: MessageWithParts
MessageWithParts.description: One message plus its parts, as returned by ``GET /session/{id}/message``.

PermissionRequest.title: PermissionRequest
PermissionRequest.description: One pending or answered ask, as persisted and streamed.

ProviderInfo.title: ProviderInfo
ProviderInfo.description: One supported LLM provider, as exposed by ``GET /provider``.

Session.title: Session
Session.description:
One agent conversation.

Subagent runs are child sessions: ``parent_id`` points at the session
whose ``task`` tool spawned them.

SyntheticMessage.title: SyntheticMessage
SyntheticMessage.description: Server-injected content, e.g. a subagent result surfaced to its parent.
